correctness.rationale: A missing row and missing column contradict domination, proving the m lower bound; any one-column size-m witness is paired for even m. Every optimum is exactly row-once or column-once, and induced cliques have perfect matchings precisely for even occupancies. The multinomial count is exact. Double moves connect each even-fiber class, cross-type overlap is at most m/2, and the explicit intersection-m/2 witness attains the threshold. Two independently designed finite checks rerun and pass for m=4 and m=6 as specified. General conclusion follows from proof, not extrapolation.

value.rationale: The natural rook-graph paired-domination problem gains an exact all-order optimum classification and exponential generating-function count. The contrast between two-move intraorientation connectivity and the sharp growing global threshold m/2 is a structural dynamical boundary with direct interpretation as minimum simultaneous recourse under paired guard coverage. This is neither a routine parameter substitution nor merely a numerical micro-enumeration; the obstruction and constructive attainment hold uniformly for arbitrarily large even m.
